reels.caption:
In the heart of Finnish Lapland, @apukkaresort offers one of the most immersive ways to experience the Arctic winter. Between panoramic igloos, snowy silence, and nights lit by the Northern Lights, the resort turns every stay into a timeless moment.

The glass cabins open directly onto the polar sky, allowing guests to admire the auroras without leaving the warmth of their bed. Husky safaris, traditional saunas, frozen lakes and long walks through untouched nature shape days where you rediscover the North in all its nuances.

A bright, peaceful retreat designed for those who dream of experiencing Lapland in its most authentic form.

📍 Apukka Resort, Rovaniemi – Lapland 🇫🇮
🎥 @apukkaresort

#hotelsguide #lapland #apukkaresort
